title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.14704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. translated_title: 代码即解释：可执行且可验证的大语言模型解释
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与人类一起做出重大决策和解决问题，我们必须理解模型是如何得出其结论的。理解LLM的行为需要在多个输入上进行观察，然而像思维链（CoT）这样的自由文本解释是针对每个实例生成的，无法在新输入上轻易验证。我们提出“代码解释”来解决LLM解释的生成方式与其评估方式之间的不匹配：用一个程序来解释LLM在整个输入数据集上的行为，并通过程序的执行实现自动验证。我们定义了“一致性”度量，衡量程序在多少比例的输入上能够复现LLM的输出，并利用该度量来评估和选择候选程序。在三个开源的具备代码能力的LLM和八个任务上的实验表明，LLM在多种设置下都能生成高度一致的代码解释。
tldr: 论文提出用可执行的代码程序来解释大语言模型在整个数据集上的行为，并通过一致性度量实现解释的自动验证，克服了自由文本解释无法在新输入上验证的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes executable code explanations that describe LLM behavior across an entire dataset of inputs, using a Consistency metric to automatically verify explanation quality and overcome the limitations of per-instance free-text explanations like chain-of-thought.
